acceptance: finish-this-task runs validate before its first bookkeeping write (status -> Complete); on failure it prints validate's own error lines and 'finish-this-task: nothing was changed', exits 1 with no Python traceback, and git status --porcelain, the index and HEAD are as before

A validate, export or digest failure (or any exception) after the bookkeeping writes and before the bookkeeping commit restores the chunk, rolled-up ancestor and registry files it wrote, prints the failing command and 'nothing was committed; fix it and run finish-this-task again', and exits 1 with no traceback

acceptance: kill_group, after verifying the group and before its first signal, reads ps once and records every transitive descendant (by parent pid) of the group's members that is outside the group, with its start time

After the group is gone, each recorded descendant still alive with the same start time gets SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the grace; a pid whose start time differs is never signalled; a survivor raises WorkerError naming its pid, so terminate does not report terminated

tests/test_worker_terminate_descendants.py (POSIX): a fake harness whose child calls os.setsid() and sleeps; worker terminate leaves neither the group nor that grandchild alive; a grandchild ignoring SIGTERM is SIGKILLed; a reused pid (start time changed) is not signalled; existing terminate and orphan tests pass unchanged
